items.issue: Same underlying recording as formal mikey-approach-017.
The participant asks about filming and is told filming has not started, while the published camera is already recording.
items.disposition: Do not treat this as informed consent. No identifiable reuse or operational endorsement; require transparent prior consent and separate publication permission.

items.issue: The interaction contains an age-18 estimate, but the number and speaker are not independently verified.
items.disposition: Do not pursue or advise romantic interaction until adulthood is clearly established; never infer age from appearance or makeup.

items.issue: Brief assent after discussing tomorrow/the day after and WeChat does not verify voluntary contact saving or a meeting.
items.disposition: Keep as unresolved planning; do not claim a successful contact or date.

items.issue: The man generalizes Chinese women's apparent age based on makeup.
items.disposition: Do not generalize gender, nationality or age from appearance.

items.issue: The request to stay longer and 'give me a chance' may pressure travel or schedule decisions.
items.disposition: Do not use emotional pressure; accept the person's own plans and uncertainty.

items.issue: Participant and bystanders are identifiable in public footage, with consent especially contradicted by the filming exchange.
items.disposition: Do not expose identities or reuse imagery without explicit privacy and publication review.

items.issue: Short turns, including the filming denial and age statement, were not independently diarized or audio-checked.
items.disposition: Keep role attribution tentative and do not quote as exact until original audio/turns are checked.
